messages:
jess: heads-up — multiple multi-node TP jobs on staging-2 are hanging in rendezvous. 3/8 ranks hit a timeout, logs show 'heartbeat mismatch' in rendezvous.c around 120s.

sam: can you paste the rendezvous log snippet? is this only on the new kernel-selector roll?

jess: paste below (trimmed):
```
[rank 2] WARNING rendezvous: heartbeat mismatch, expected 0x1f3 got 0x1f2
[rank 5] ERROR timeout waiting for all ranks (120s)
[rank 7] info: negotiated tp-partition=2, kv-cache-enabled=true
```

ria: I ran a quick nccl microprofile on the same node set — tail allreduce on rank4 is spiking ~180-220ms instead of usual 20-40ms. Looks correlated with an extra memcpy before the allreduce.

kai: hmm, we shipped the kernel-selector change that prefers the vectorized fused-kv kernel when sequence_len < 512. That kernel path does a small host->device staging for some edge cases. If one node picks fused-kv and another picks tiled-kv we could get mismatched rendezvous metadata.

sam: are CUDA / NCCL versions identical across the nodes? last incident we saw version skew cause different kernel choices.

jess: checked — CUDA 12.2 on all, NCCL 2.18 on all. But one machine has a slightly older driver (535.86 vs 535.90).

ria: attached profile snippet from rank4 (nvprof style):
```
Memcpy HtoD  0.19s  (extra staging)
AllReduce  0.21s
Compute kernel 0.02s
```

kai: that fits. kernel-selector does a capability check that includes driver quirks. The mismatch would make the rendezvous exchange report different "kernel flavor" which our rendezvous currently treats as fatal (heartbeat mismatch).

sam: short-term mitigation: force the older kernel path by setting REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=tiled-v1 (env on all nodes) while we triage. If that stops the hangs we're on the right track.

jess: trying a canary with override on 4/4 nodes now. will report.

infra-bot: scheduled run 2026-03-18T14:12:05Z (canary) on staging-2.

jess: canary complete — no rendezvous timeouts, allreduce tail normalized to ~30ms. Looks like override fixed it.

kai: ok, root cause is selector divergence triggered by driver micro-version. Action items: (1) add selector deterministic fallback during rendezvous (2) emit more explicit kernel-flavor in rendezvous handshake for easier debugging (3) include a health-check that fails fast when flavors disagree instead of hanging. I'll open a PR for (2) + (1) follow-up.

sam: also add a quick e2e test that runs small TP job across mixed-driver matrix in CI so this doesn't regress.

jess: thanks — saving logs to /mnt/archives/rendezvous-1937654321.log and tagging this thread in the incident board.

deploy-bot: rolled back kernel-selector feature flag on staging at 1937654520 per request.

ria: leaving a perf note — batching heuristics interacts with this because smaller batches hit the fused-kv codepath more often. We should add a telemetry tag for 'kv_kernel' used per-request so Optimize can spot correlations.

kai: noted. opening PRs and will link them here.

sam: great triage, short-term fix looks solid. we'll schedule a dedicated postmortem if it reappears. :thumbsup:
